title: factory.artifact-view/v1 — sidecar rendering hints over an agent's output schema (docs/event-runtime-artifact-views.md §2.2)
description: A closed hint vocabulary, not a layout language. Per-`as` key applicability (table→columns/groupBy/expand, keyvalue→keys, list→itemLabel, code→language) and the pointer→schema drift check are enforced by lib/artifact-view.mjs, because lib/schema.mjs has no conditional keywords.

summary.description: RFC 6901 pointer into the artifact to a string rendered first, as prose

columns.description: table only: item properties shown as columns, in order

groupBy.description: table only: item property whose value groups the rows

expand.description: table only: item properties shown only in the row's expanded state

keys.description: keyvalue only: subset of the object's properties, in order

itemLabel.description: list only: pointer relative to each item naming the text shown

formats.description: column/key (or "" for the section value itself) → format

tone.description: table/keyvalue/list: column/key → (value → tone); badge: value → tone
